subject: Post-call: next steps + rotating tri-zone demo availability
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@callistohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: next steps + rotating tri-zone demo availability

Hi Sara — great chat this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary (1-liner): Callisto is evaluating server-side inference for patient triage routing; primary goals are predictable latency (<= 200ms p50) and cost-efficiency across burst traffic.

Key takeaways:
- Primary workload: short text responses (avg 120 tokens), ~200 TPS at peak, bursty mornings (US) and evenings (APAC).
- Security/compliance needs: SOC 2 in-scope, data residency questions for EU customers.
- Stakeholders: Sara (Product Owner), Oliver (DevOps), procurement to follow after technical sign-off.

Requested follow-ups (we committed):
1) Technical deep dive (30–45 min) to validate latency/caching model and discuss quantization tradeoffs — proposed owners: Karthik (tech lead) + Tessa (sales).
2) Share mutual action plan and a simple rotating calendar pattern that lets Callisto invite multiple regional teams.
3) Procurement pre-read (pricing band and SOW template) after demo.

Rotating demo proposal (goal: make recurring scheduling equitable across US/EU/APAC):
- Weekly 30-min deep dive, rotating time window each week across regions. Example rotation (all listed in UTC for clarity):
  • Week 1 (US-friendly): Tue 16:00 UTC (09:00 PT / 12:00 ET)
  • Week 2 (EU-friendly): Thu 13:00 UTC (14:00 CET / 15:00 EET)
  • Week 3 (APAC-friendly): Wed 02:00 UTC (10:00 SGT / 11:30 ACDT) — we can shift APAC earlier/later based on team preference
- Each session will be recorded and key config snippets shared.

Ask: Can you and Oliver indicate 2–3 recurring windows that work for your teams? I set up a short Doodle and attached a draft mutual action plan. If a rotating weekly cadence looks good, we can lock a 6-week pilot schedule and invite attendees by role.

Attachments: Callisto_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf (draft), rotating-demo-templates.ics (three template slots).

Thanks — I’ll wait for your availability and will share a concrete calendar poll.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0172
https://redwoodinference.com

--
Redwood Inference — production-grade inference for teams
From: Sara Lopez <sara@callistohealth.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Chen <oliver@callistohealth.com>
Date: Wed, 20 May 2026 18:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps + rotating tri-zone demo availability

Thanks, Tessa — appreciated the clear recap. Oliver and I reviewed with the on-call rota owner; we like the rotating idea. A few quick notes:

- The APAC team prefers sessions between 09:00–12:00 SGT where possible (our Singapore ops team is most available in their morning).
- EU coverage: mid-day CET works best for our clinicians.
- For US participants, mornings PT are easiest (we have east-coast folks who can join a bit later).

We can do a weekly rotation but would prefer a 6-week pilot (same cadence you suggested). Can you do Week 1 starting Tue Jun 1? Also, can Karthik show a short demo of KV/prefix caching and a brief quantization tradeoff slide?

I filled in the Doodle with tentative preferences — I left one APAC slot loose so our Sydney engineer can join where possible.

Sara
Product Lead — Callisto Health
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Lopez <sara@callistohealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 08:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps + rotating tri-zone demo availability

Great — thanks for the quick reply and for filling out the poll. I’ve attached the mutual action plan (v1) and created three rotating templates as .ics attachments (also attached).

Concrete suggestion to lock in the pilot:
- Pilot length: 6 weeks (starting Tue, 1 Jun 2026)
- Frequency: weekly, 30 minutes
- Rotation sequence (we’ll publish in the recurring invite):
  • Week A (US): Tue 16:00 UTC — 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
  • Week B (EU): Thu 13:00 UTC — 14:00 CET
  • Week C (APAC): Wed 02:00 UTC — 10:00 SGT
- Attendees: Sara, Oliver, Callisto eng lead (TBD), Karthik (tech deep dive), Ben (pricing/next steps)

Karthik — below are the bullets Sara asked for. Please confirm you can demo KV/prefix caching and bring a slide about quantization/memory tradeoffs (approx 10–12 minutes of the 30). Also flag any tooling or infra pre-reqs you need from Callisto (sample traffic shape, short burst log, example prompt sets).

Ben — I’ll need you to prepare a one-slide pricing band and high-level procurement timeline we can share after the second session.

Next step: I’ll send the recurring invite after the Doodle finalizes; if Callisto picks the rotating pattern we’ll publish the 6-week series and include recordings + short runbook.

Thanks all — attaching the docs.

Tessa

Attachments: Callisto_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.pdf, rotating-demo-templates.ics
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 11:05:00 +0530
Subject: Re: Post-call: next steps + rotating tri-zone demo availability

Thanks — I can take the tech deep dive. Quick notes for the Callisto team (so they can prep):
- I’ll demo: KV/prefix caching behavior under bursty workloads, and a small experiment showing p50/p95 changes with and without cache.
- I’ll prepare a short quantization explainer with benchmarks for int8 vs float16 (latency impact and memory footprint).
- Please send a sample prompt set (5–10 examples) and a recent 15-minute traffic snippet if you can — helps reproduce latency characteristics.

I’m fine with the rotation sequence Tessa proposed. If APAC needs a slightly later slot (e.g., 04:00 UTC instead of 02:00 UTC) we can adjust — call that out in the Doodle.

Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
